title: Hummus Hued Turkish Lamb Kidney Kebabs
description: Tender lamb kidney kebabs infused with the brininess of pickled turnips, perfect for a weeknight meal. A unique twist on traditional Turkish cuisine, this dish is fodmap-friendly and sure to please.

ingredients.name: Sumac
ingredients.notes: Optional, but recommended for authentic flavor.

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together lamb kidneys, pickled turnips, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add olive oil to the bowl and mix until the lamb is well coated.
Thread the lamb and pickled turnips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with additional olive oil and season with sumac if using.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
